prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Mamta didi, Subhash bhai, Prakash bhai, Subhash N..
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 8:30 pm and 9:39 pm: 9 messages
- between 9:39 pm and 10:30 pm: 12 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "8:32 pm", "sender": "Mamta didi", "text": "Subhash bhai woh wala hisaab dekh liya kya?"},
  {"time": "8:37 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Haan didi, sab samajh aa gaya hai."},
  {"time": "8:41 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Main bhi dukaan par aane wala hoon."},
  {"time": "8:48 pm", "sender": "Subhash N.", "text": "Chai ka plan hai kya aaj?"},
  {"time": "8:55 pm", "sender": "Mamta didi", "text": "Haan bilkul, sab log milte hain thodi der mein."},
  {"time": "9:05 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Purana hisaab clear kar diya hai maine."},
  {"time": "9:14 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, mera bhi poora ho gaya."},
  {"time": "9:22 pm", "sender": "Subhash N.", "text": "Sab log time par aa jana bas."},
  {"time": "9:35 pm", "sender": "Mamta didi", "text": "Main kuch nashta bhi le aayungi."},
  {"time": "9:41 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Didi notebook diary ke saath rakh di hai."},
  {"time": "9:45 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Acha suno, kharche ki baat karni thi."},
  {"time": "9:50 pm", "sender": "Mamta didi", "text": "Haan bolo Subhash bhai, kya baat hai?"},
  {"time": "9:54 pm", "sender": "Subhash N.", "text": "Kharcha aapas mein baant lenge na?"},
  {"time": "10:01 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Sahi baat hai, barabar hissa hoga sabka."},
  {"time": "10:07 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Maine apna hissa jod liya hai."},
  {"time": "10:12 pm", "sender": "Mamta didi", "text": "Mera bhi taiyaar hai hisaab."},
  {"time": "10:16 pm", "sender": "Subhash N.", "text": "Baaki baatein milkar karte hain."},
  {"time": "10:20 pm", "sender": "Prakash bhai", "text": "Main bas nikalne hi wala hoon ghar se."},
  {"time": "10:24 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Dukaan par hi mil rahe hain na sab?"},
  {"time": "10:27 pm", "sender": "Mamta didi", "text": "Haan dukaan ke baahar hi hain hum."},
  {"time": "10:29 pm", "sender": "Subhash N.", "text": "Main bhi bas abhi pahocha."}
]
